study: SOCTRA-HLS phase 2: classifier operating points and SOC operational impact

simulation.acceptance: automatic recommendation acceptance; controlled assumption, not measured analyst behavior
simulation.within_class_error_assumption: pD and pFA are exchangeable across synthetic project classes because individual predictions and class-stratified error rates are unavailable
simulation.capacity_design: L2 roster size 2/3/4; demand lambda_L1 is held constant across L2 roster sizes for each label definition, prevalence, rho_L1 and seed. The frozen roster builder cycles its declared L2 competence/service profiles when n_L2 exceeds three; report this compositional caveat.

original_test_exact_audited.definition: 39/14449 exact test-partition prevalence from the audited SOCTRA data inventory; article Table 2 rounded IR=360.23 implies 40/14449, a one-alert discrepancy documented in the report

original_full_count_as_provided.definition: 210/63410 supplied for the full historical evaluation population; used as a prevalence sensitivity, not the test partition prevalence

standardized_article_test_table2_inferre.definition: 19/14449 inferred exactly from article Table 2 test IR=759.47 (14,430 negatives, 19 positives); not replaced by original-label prevalence

simulation_selection.rule: Include every pD/pFA Pareto-frontier point from the relevant published label group, plus one dominated high-false-alarm/detection-comparable control: Bayesian MLP A for original labels and RF A+C for standardized labels. The frontier is fixed from the article tables before simulation.

bayes_benefit_sensitivity.note: Compute normalized Bayes benefit from published pD/pFA as a cost-sensitivity view only. The published tables do not provide distinct model operating points by these cost ratios; do not call derived values separate trained/evaluated classifiers.

statistical.paired_seed_unit: one seed trace within a fixed label definition, prevalence, rho_L1 and classifier point; the same trace/recommendation uniforms are shared across policies and classifier points; L2 capacity changes are paired on that same trace
statistical.interval: two-sided 95% paired Student-t interval, df=39, exploratory, unadjusted unless stated
statistical.multiple_comparisons: No familywise correction for the full point matrix; operational Pareto results are descriptive.
